# Tool reference

<!-- Generated by `make docs` (go run ./cmd/gen-tool-docs) from the tool definitions. Do not edit by hand. -->

emby-mcp has **34 tools** in **7 toolsets**: 17 read, 15 write and 2 delete. It also has **6 prompts**.

Each tool is labelled with the setting it needs:

| Label | Registered when |
|---|---|
| 🟢 read | Always |
| 🟠 write | `EMBY_ALLOW_WRITES=true` |
| 🔴 delete | `EMBY_ALLOW_WRITES=true` and `EMBY_ALLOW_DELETES=true` (they delete collections and playlists, never media files) |

Every tool also needs its toolset to be enabled in `EMBY_TOOLSETS`, which enables every toolset except `raw` by default, and not to be listed in `EMBY_DENY_TOOLS`. Items are addressed by their Emby ID, which the search and list tools return; tools that take one item also accept its exact title. Bulk tools take up to 500 item IDs per call. Read tools return compact summaries, and many take `raw: true` for Emby's full objects. Played state and favourites belong to one user: tools use the default user (`EMBY_USER`, or the first administrator) unless given `user`. Every tool that changes something takes `dry_run: true` to preview the change.

## Contents

- [`library`](#library): Find and read: server and library overview, search with rich filters, item details, the tags, genres and studios in use, similar items, recently added and continue watching.
- [`metadata`](#metadata): Curate: add and remove tags on many items at once, rename or merge tags, edit metadata fields and locks, and refresh metadata from the internet.
- [`collections`](#collections): Collections (Emby box sets): list, view, create, add to, remove from and delete.
- [`playlists`](#playlists): Playlists: list, view, create, add to, remove from and delete.
- [`users`](#users): Users, and each user's watched state and favourites.
- [`server`](#server): The server: what's playing now, the activity log, scheduled tasks and library scans.
- [`raw`](#raw): A raw API escape hatch for anything the other tools don't cover. It isn't part of `EMBY_TOOLSETS=all`, so list it by name (for example `all,raw`). It is limited to GET requests unless writes are enabled, needs `EMBY_ALLOW_DELETES` for deletes and changes to users, API keys and the server, and redacts secrets.
- [Prompts](#prompts)

## library

Find and read: server and library overview, search with rich filters, item details, the tags, genres and studios in use, similar items, recently added and continue watching.

| Tool | Access | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`emby_get_item`](#emby_get_item) | 🟢 read | Item details |
| [`emby_get_server_info`](#emby_get_server_info) | 🟢 read | Server, libraries and counts |
| [`emby_get_similar`](#emby_get_similar) | 🟢 read | Similar items |
| [`emby_list_latest`](#emby_list_latest) | 🟢 read | Recently added |
| [`emby_list_libraries`](#emby_list_libraries) | 🟢 read | List libraries |
| [`emby_list_resume`](#emby_list_resume) | 🟢 read | Continue watching |

| [`emby_search_items`](#emby_search_items) | 🟢 read | Search the library |

### emby_get_item

🟢 read

Everything about one item: title, original title, year and premiere date, ratings, runtime, plot, tagline, genres, tags, studios, the collections it's in, directors, writers and cast, provider IDs (TMDb, IMDb, TVDb), date added, file path, media (resolution, HDR, codecs, audio and subtitle tracks, size), locked metadata fields, and the user's watched state and progress. Give the ID, or a title that matches one item.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `item` | string | yes | The item's ID, or its exact title |
| `raw` | boolean |  | Return Emby's full objects instead of compact summaries (much larger) |
| `user` | string |  | Emby user (name or ID) whose played state, favourites and access to use. Default: EMBY_USER, or the first administrator |

### emby_get_server_info

🟢 read

A first look at the Emby server: name, version, whether an update or restart is pending, the user the tools act as, each library with its type, and how many films, series, episodes, collections and other items there are. Also says whether changes are allowed.

_No arguments._

### emby_get_similar

🟢 read

Items Emby considers similar to one item (by genre, people and studio), with the user's watched state: good for "something like X" recommendations or for finding candidates for a collection.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `item` | string | yes | The item's ID, or its exact title |
| `limit` | integer (1–100) |  | How many (default 12) |
| `user` | string |  | Emby user (name or ID) whose played state, favourites and access to use. Default: EMBY_USER, or the first administrator |

### emby_list_latest

🟢 read

The most recently added items, newest first, as on Emby's home screen: optionally only some types or one library. New episodes of a series are grouped under the series unless group is false.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | boolean |  | Group new episodes under their series (default true) |
| `library` | string |  | Only this library (name or ID) |
| `limit` | integer (1–200) |  | How many (default 20) |
| `types` | string[] |  | Only these item types, such as ["Movie"] or ["Episode"] |
| `user` | string |  | Emby user (name or ID) whose played state, favourites and access to use. Default: EMBY_USER, or the first administrator |

### emby_list_libraries

🟢 read

List the Emby libraries: name, ID (use it as library or parent_id), content type (movies, tvshows, music...), the folders on disk, and the settings that matter for curation: metadata language and country, whether Emby imports collections (such as TMDb film series) automatically and the minimum size for one, whether metadata is saved next to the media (NFO files), and the automatic refresh interval.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `raw` | boolean |  | Return Emby's full objects instead of compact summaries (much larger) |

### emby_list_resume

🟢 read

What the user has started but not finished (Emby's "Continue watching"), most recent first, with how far through each one they are.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer (1–200) |  | How many (default 20) |
| `types` | string[] |  | Only these item types, such as ["Movie"] or ["Episode"] |
| `user` | string |  | Emby user (name or ID) whose played state, favourites and access to use. Default: EMBY_USER, or the first administrator |

### emby_list_values

🟢 read

List the values in use in the library for one kind of metadata: tags, genres, studios, parental ratings or years. Narrow it to item types or a library, or filter the names. with_counts adds how many items have each value (it reads every matching item, so it's slower on big libraries), sorted most-used first. Use it before tagging to reuse existing tag names instead of inventing near-duplicates.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `"tags"` \| `"genres"` \| `"studios"` \| `"ratings"` \| `"years"` | yes | Which values to list |
| `filter` | string |  | Only names containing this text (case-insensitive) |
| `library` | string |  | Only values used in this library (name or ID) |
| `types` | string[] |  | Only values used by these item types, such as ["Movie"] |
| `user` | string |  | Emby user (name or ID) whose played state, favourites and access to use. Default: EMBY_USER, or the first administrator |
| `with_counts` | boolean |  | Count the items with each value |

### emby_search_items

🟢 read

Find items in the Emby library: films, series, episodes, collections, music and more. Combine any filters: text, type, library, genres, tags (or untagged), years, parental rating, community and critic ratings, person, studio, watched or favourite (for the user), in progress, missing metadata (such as no overview or no TMDb ID), or a list of IDs. Returns compact items with IDs, year, rating, runtime, genres, tags and watched state, sorted and paged (total, offset, next_offset). include_overview adds a short plot summary, for deciding tags or recommending something.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `exclude_tags` | string[] |  | Leave out items with any of these tags |
| `favorite` | boolean |  | true: only the user's favourites; false: leave them out |
| `genres` | string[] |  | Items with any of these genres |
| `group_into_collections` | boolean |  | Show collections in place of the films they contain, as Emby's library view does |
| `ids` | string[] |  | Only these item IDs |
| `in_progress` | boolean |  | Only items the user has started but not finished |
| `include_overview` | boolean |  | Add each item's plot summary (shortened), for example to decide tags |
| `library` | string |  | Only this library (name or ID), such as Movies |
| `limit` | integer (1–500) |  | How many items to return (default 50) |
| `max_rating` | string |  | Items rated at most this (such as PG-13 or 12), for family viewing |
| `min_community_rating` | number (0–10) |  | Minimum community (audience) rating, 0 to 10 |
| `min_critic_rating` | number (0–100) |  | Minimum critic rating, 0 to 100 |
| `missing` | string[] |  | Only items missing any of these, to find gaps in the metadata |
| `offset` | integer |  | How many matching items to skip, for paging (use next_offset from the last call) |
| `parent_id` | string |  | Only items inside this item: a collection, playlist, series, season or folder ID |
| `person` | string |  | Items featuring this person (actor, director, writer...) |
| `person_types` | string[] |  | With person: only these roles, such as ["Director"] |
| `played` | boolean |  | true: only watched items; false: only unwatched (for the user) |
| `query` | string |  | Text to search for in titles (Emby's search: names, original titles and people) |
| `ratings` | string[] |  | Items with any of these parental ratings, such as ["PG","12"] |
| `raw` | boolean |  | Return Emby's full objects instead of compact summaries (much larger) |
| `sort_by` | `"community_rating"` \| `"critic_rating"` \| `"date_added"` \| `"date_played"` \| `"name"` \| `"play_count"` \| `"premiere_date"` \| `"random"` \| `"runtime"` \| `"year"` |  | Sort order (default name; date_added for newest first with sort_order descending) |
| `sort_order` | `"ascending"` \| `"descending"` |  | ascending (default) or descending |
| `studios` | string[] |  | Items from any of these studios or networks |
| `tags` | string[] |  | Items with any of these tags |
| `types` | string[] |  | Item types to include, such as ["Movie"] or ["Series"]. Default: every type except folders |
| `untagged` | boolean |  | Only items with no tags at all (useful when tagging a library a batch at a time) |
| `user` | string |  | Emby user (name or ID) whose played state, favourites and access to use. Default: EMBY_USER, or the first administrator |
| `year_from` | integer |  | Items from this year or later |
| `year_to` | integer |  | Items from this year or earlier |
| `years` | integer[] |  | Items from any of these production years |

## metadata

Curate: add and remove tags on many items at once, rename or merge tags, edit metadata fields and locks, and refresh metadata from the internet.

| Tool | Access | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`emby_add_tags`](#emby_add_tags) | 🟠 write | Add tags to items |
| [`emby_refresh_item`](#emby_refresh_item) | 🟠 write | Refresh metadata |
| [`emby_remove_tags`](#emby_remove_tags) | 🟠 write | Remove tags from items |
| [`emby_rename_tag`](#emby_rename_tag) | 🟠 write | Rename or merge a tag |
| [`emby_update_item`](#emby_update_item) | 🟠 write | Edit item metadata |

### emby_add_tags

🟠 write

Add up to 20 tags to up to 500 items in one call: the way to tag a library, such as tagging every Christmas film "Christmas". Items that already have a tag are skipped for it, and existing tags are kept. Group items by tag and make one call per tag (or set of tags). lock: true also locks the Tags field on each item, so a metadata refresh with 'replace all' can't remove the tags. Tags are shared by every user. Returns what changed per item.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `item_ids` | string[] | yes | IDs of the items to change (up to 500), from emby_search_items |
| `tags` | string[] | yes | Tag names, such as ["Christmas","Heist"]. Reuse existing names (emby_list_values kind tags) rather than near-duplicates |
| `dry_run` | boolean |  | Preview only: check the call and return the first request it would send to Emby, with the current state and the fields that would change, without sending anything. Nothing is changed |
| `lock` | boolean |  | Also lock each item's Tags field against metadata refreshes |

### emby_refresh_item

🟠 write

Ask Emby to refresh items' metadata and images from the internet (TMDb, TVDb...), as "Refresh metadata" in Emby. mode missing (default) fills in what's missing and keeps everything else; scan only rescans the files; replace_all downloads all metadata again and overwrites every field that isn't locked, which can remove tags and edits made in Emby, so it needs confirm: true. A series or collection refreshes its contents too. Refreshing runs in the background on the server.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `item_ids` | string[] | yes | IDs of the items to refresh (up to 500) |
| `confirm` | boolean |  | Must be true. Only set it once the user has agreed to this specific change |
| `dry_run` | boolean |  | Preview only: check the call and return the first request it would send to Emby, with the current state and the fields that would change, without sending anything. Nothing is changed |
| `mode` | `"missing"` \| `"scan"` \| `"replace_all"` |  | missing (default), scan or replace_all |
| `replace_images` | boolean |  | Download all images again too (with replace_all) |

### emby_remove_tags

🟠 write

Remove up to 20 tags from up to 500 items in one call. Items without the tag are skipped. Other tags are kept. To remove a tag everywhere, find its items with emby_search_items (tags: [name]) first, or use emby_rename_tag to merge it into another tag.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `item_ids` | string[] | yes | IDs of the items to change (up to 500), from emby_search_items |
| `tags` | string[] | yes | Tag names, such as ["Christmas","Heist"]. Reuse existing names (emby_list_values kind tags) rather than near-duplicates |
| `dry_run` | boolean |  | Preview only: check the call and return the first request it would send to Emby, with the current state and the fields that would change, without sending anything. Nothing is changed |

### emby_rename_tag

🟠 write

Rename a tag on every item that has it (or only items of some types, or in one library), for example to fix "xmas" to "Christmas" or merge "Sci Fi" into "Science Fiction". If the new name already exists, the items join it. Returns the items changed.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | string | yes | The tag to rename |
| `to` | string | yes | Its new name (an existing tag to merge into, or a new one) |
| `dry_run` | boolean |  | Preview only: check the call and return the first request it would send to Emby, with the current state and the fields that would change, without sending anything. Nothing is changed |
| `library` | string |  | Only items in this library (name or ID) |
| `types` | string[] |  | Only items of these types |

### emby_update_item

🟠 write

Edit an item's metadata, as in Emby's metadata editor: title, sort title, original title, plot, tagline, genres, studios, parental and custom rating, community and critic rating, production year and premiere date. It also locks or unlocks fields, so later metadata refreshes leave them alone. Only the fields given change. Edited fields are locked automatically unless lock_edited is false. It also works on collections and playlists, for example to rename a collection or give it a description. To change tags, use emby_add_tags and emby_remove_tags. Saving an item makes Emby match its cast and crew by name, as its own metadata editor does; if that links someone to a different person with the same name, the result says so.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `item` | string | yes | The item's ID, or its exact title |
| `community_rating` | number (0–10) |  | Community rating, 0 to 10 |
| `critic_rating` | number (0–100) |  | Critic rating, 0 to 100 |
| `custom_rating` | string |  | Custom rating, used by parental controls instead of the official one (empty to clear) |
| `dry_run` | boolean |  | Preview only: check the call and return the first request it would send to Emby, with the current state and the fields that would change, without sending anything. Nothing is changed |
| `genres` | string[] |  | The complete new list of genres (replaces the current ones) |
| `lock_all` | boolean |  | Lock (true) or unlock (false) all of the item's metadata, so refreshes don't touch it |
| `lock_edited` | boolean |  | Lock the fields this call edits (default true), so a refresh doesn't undo them |
| `lock_fields` | `"Name"` \| `"SortName"` \| `"OriginalTitle"` \| `"Overview"` \| `"Tagline"` \| `"Genres"` \| `"Tags"` \| `"Studios"` \| `"Cast"` \| `"OfficialRating"` \| `"CommunityRating"` \| `"CriticRating"` \| `"Runtime"` \| `"ProductionLocations"` \| `"Collections"`[] |  | Fields to lock against metadata refreshes |
| `name` | string |  | New title |
| `official_rating` | string |  | Parental rating, such as PG-13 or 12A (empty to clear) |
| `original_title` | string |  | Original-language title |
| `overview` | string |  | Plot summary or description |
| `premiere_date` | string |  | Premiere or release date, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `production_year` | integer (1850–2200) |  | Production year |
| `sort_name` | string |  | Title to sort by, such as "Godfather, The" (empty to clear) |
| `studios` | string[] |  | The complete new list of studios (replaces the current ones) |
| `tagline` | string |  | Tagline (empty to clear) |
| `unlock_fields` | `"Name"` \| `"SortName"` \| `"OriginalTitle"` \| `"Overview"` \| `"Tagline"` \| `"Genres"` \| `"Tags"` \| `"Studios"` \| `"Cast"` \| `"OfficialRating"` \| `"CommunityRating"` \| `"CriticRating"` \| `"Runtime"` \| `"ProductionLocations"` \| `"Collections"`[] |  | Fields to unlock |

## collections

Collections (Emby box sets): list, view, create, add to, remove from and delete.

| Tool | Access | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`emby_add_to_collection`](#emby_add_to_collection) | 🟠 write | Add to a collection |
| [`emby_create_collection`](#emby_create_collection) | 🟠 write | Create a collection |
| [`emby_delete_collection`](#emby_delete_collection) | 🔴 delete | Delete a collection |
| [`emby_get_collection`](#emby_get_collection) | 🟢 read | Collection contents |

| [`emby_remove_from_collection`](#emby_remove_from_collection) | 🟠 write | Remove from a collection |

### emby_add_to_collection

🟠 write

Add items to an existing collection (up to 500 per call). Items already in it are skipped.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `collection` | string | yes | The collection's ID or exact name |
| `item_ids` | string[] | yes | IDs of the items to add |
| `dry_run` | boolean |  | Preview only: check the call and return the first request it would send to Emby, with the current state and the fields that would change, without sending anything. Nothing is changed |

### emby_create_collection

🟠 write

Create a collection (an Emby box set) from a list of items, such as "Christmas Classics" or "Best of Studio Ghibli". Emby shows the films grouped under it. It refuses a name that's already a collection, unless allow_duplicate is true: add to the existing one with emby_add_to_collection instead. lock: true stops metadata refreshes renaming it or changing its description.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | The collection's name |
| `allow_duplicate` | boolean |  | Create it even if a collection already has this name |
| `dry_run` | boolean |  | Preview only: check the call and return the first request it would send to Emby, with the current state and the fields that would change, without sending anything. Nothing is changed |
| `item_ids` | string[] |  | IDs of the items to put in it (up to 500) |
| `lock` | boolean |  | Lock its metadata against refreshes |
| `overview` | string |  | A description for the collection |

### emby_delete_collection

🔴 delete · destructive

Delete a collection. The films and episodes in it are not touched: only the collection itself goes. Needs confirm: true.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `collection` | string | yes | The collection's ID or exact name |
| `confirm` | boolean |  | Must be true. Only set it once the user has agreed to this specific change |
| `dry_run` | boolean |  | Preview only: check the call and return the first request it would send to Emby, with the current state and the fields that would change, without sending anything. Nothing is changed |

### emby_get_collection

🟢 read

Show a collection and everything in it, in release order, with each item's ID, year, rating and the user's watched state.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `collection` | string | yes | The collection's ID or exact name |
| `include_overview` | boolean |  | Add each item's plot summary |
| `user` | string |  | Emby user (name or ID) whose played state, favourites and access to use. Default: EMBY_USER, or the first administrator |

### emby_list_collections

🟢 read

List the collections (Emby box sets, such as "Star Wars Collection" or your own "Christmas Classics"), with how many items each holds. Filter by name.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `include_overview` | boolean |  | Add each collection's description |
| `limit` | integer (1–500) |  | How many (default 100) |
| `offset` | integer |  | How many to skip, for paging |
| `query` | string |  | Only collections whose name contains this |

### emby_remove_from_collection

🟠 write

Take items out of a collection (up to 500 per call). The items stay in the library; only their place in the collection goes.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `collection` | string | yes | The collection's ID or exact name |
| `item_ids` | string[] | yes | IDs of the items to remove |
| `dry_run` | boolean |  | Preview only: check the call and return the first request it would send to Emby, with the current state and the fields that would change, without sending anything. Nothing is changed |

### emby_add_to_playlist

🟠 write

| `item_ids` | string[] | yes | IDs of the items to add |
| `playlist` | string | yes | The playlist's ID or exact name |
| `allow_repeats` | boolean |  | Add items even if they're already in the playlist |
| `dry_run` | boolean |  | Preview only: check the call and return the first request it would send to Emby, with the current state and the fields that would change, without sending anything. Nothing is changed |

### emby_create_playlist

🟠 write

Create a playlist from items in the order given, such as a film marathon or a run of episodes. It belongs to the user (default: the server's default user).

| `name` | string | yes | The playlist's name |
| `dry_run` | boolean |  | Preview only: check the call and return the first request it would send to Emby, with the current state and the fields that would change, without sending anything. Nothing is changed |
| `item_ids` | string[] |  | IDs of the items, in order (up to 500) |
| `media_type` | `"Video"` \| `"Audio"` |  | Video or Audio (default: from the items, else Video) |
| `user` | string |  | Emby user (name or ID) whose played state, favourites and access to use. Default: EMBY_USER, or the first administrator |

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |

🟢 read

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |

## users

Users, and each user's watched state and favourites.

| Tool | Access | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`emby_list_users`](#emby_list_users) | 🟢 read | List users |
| [`emby_set_favorite`](#emby_set_favorite) | 🟠 write | Add or remove favourites |
| [`emby_set_played`](#emby_set_played) | 🟠 write | Mark played or unplayed |

### emby_list_users

🟢 read

List the Emby users: name, ID, whether each is an administrator, disabled or hidden, when they last signed in and were last active, and their parental control limit. Shows which one the tools use by default. Never shows passwords.

_No arguments._

### emby_set_favorite

🟠 write

Add items to a user's favourites, or take them out (up to 500 per call). Favourites are per user.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `favorite` | boolean | yes | true to add to favourites, false to remove |
| `item_ids` | string[] | yes | IDs of the items |
| `dry_run` | boolean |  | Preview only: check the call and return the first request it would send to Emby, with the current state and the fields that would change, without sending anything. Nothing is changed |
| `user` | string |  | Emby user (name or ID) whose played state, favourites and access to use. Default: EMBY_USER, or the first administrator |

### emby_set_played

🟠 write

Mark items as watched or unwatched for a user (up to 500 per call). Marking a series or season marks all its episodes. Watched state is per user.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `item_ids` | string[] | yes | IDs of the items |
| `played` | boolean | yes | true to mark watched, false to mark unwatched |
| `date` | string |  | When it was watched, YYYY-MM-DD (default now; only with played true) |
| `dry_run` | boolean |  | Preview only: check the call and return the first request it would send to Emby, with the current state and the fields that would change, without sending anything. Nothing is changed |
| `user` | string |  | Emby user (name or ID) whose played state, favourites and access to use. Default: EMBY_USER, or the first administrator |

## server

The server: what's playing now, the activity log, scheduled tasks and library scans.

| Tool | Access | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`emby_list_activity`](#emby_list_activity) | 🟢 read | Activity log |
| [`emby_list_scheduled_tasks`](#emby_list_scheduled_tasks) | 🟢 read | Scheduled tasks |
| [`emby_list_sessions`](#emby_list_sessions) | 🟢 read | Now playing |
| [`emby_run_scheduled_task`](#emby_run_scheduled_task) | 🟠 write | Run a scheduled task |
| [`emby_scan_library`](#emby_scan_library) | 🟠 write | Scan for new media |

### emby_list_activity

🟢 read

The server's activity log, newest first: playback started and stopped, sign-ins, new items added, scheduled task results, errors and warnings. Filter by date, severity or text.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `filter` | string |  | Only entries whose name, type or description contains this |
| `limit` | integer (1–500) |  | How many (default 50) |
| `min_severity` | `"Info"` \| `"Warning"` \| `"Error"` |  | Only entries at least this severe |
| `since` | string |  | Only entries from this date or time on (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339) |

### emby_list_scheduled_tasks

🟢 read

The server's scheduled tasks (library scan, metadata refresh, chapter images, backups from plugins...): each one's state and progress if running, and when it last ran and how that went. To start one, use its key or name.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `include_hidden` | boolean |  | Include tasks Emby hides from its dashboard |

### emby_list_sessions

🟢 read

Who's using Emby right now: each active session's user, app and device, and what's playing (title, position, paused, and whether it's direct playing or transcoding, with the reason). Idle sessions are left out unless include_idle is true.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `include_idle` | boolean |  | Also list connected apps that aren't playing anything |

### emby_run_scheduled_task

🟠 write

Start a scheduled task now, such as "Scan media library" or "Refresh people". Give its key, ID or name from emby_list_scheduled_tasks. It runs in the background.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task` | string | yes | The task's key, ID or name |
| `dry_run` | boolean |  | Preview only: check the call and return the first request it would send to Emby, with the current state and the fields that would change, without sending anything. Nothing is changed |

### emby_scan_library

🟠 write

Scan for new, changed and removed files: every library, or one library. New films and episodes appear once the scan finds them. The scan runs in the background.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dry_run` | boolean |  | Preview only: check the call and return the first request it would send to Emby, with the current state and the fields that would change, without sending anything. Nothing is changed |
| `library` | string |  | Only this library (name or ID); default all |

## raw

A raw API escape hatch for anything the other tools don't cover. It isn't part of `EMBY_TOOLSETS=all`, so list it by name (for example `all,raw`). It is limited to GET requests unless writes are enabled, needs `EMBY_ALLOW_DELETES` for deletes and changes to users, API keys and the server, and redacts secrets.

| Tool | Access | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`emby_api_request`](#emby_api_request) | 🟢 read | Raw Emby API request |

### emby_api_request

🟢 read · destructive

Call any path of Emby's REST API directly, for anything the other tools don't cover. Paths are listed in the server's own API documentation at /emby/openapi.json. Secrets in responses (access tokens, API keys, passwords) are redacted. All methods are allowed, including restarts and changes to users and API keys, but never deleting library items (which would delete media files). Changes go straight to Emby with no checks: confirm them with the user first.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Path of Emby's REST API (as in the server's /emby/openapi.json), without /emby, such as /Items/Counts or /Users/{UserId}/Items |
| `body` | any |  | JSON request body for POST |
| `dry_run` | boolean |  | Preview only: check the call and return the first request it would send to Emby, with the current state and the fields that would change, without sending anything. Nothing is changed |
| `method` | `"GET"` \| `"POST"` \| `"DELETE"` |  | HTTP method: GET (default), POST or DELETE |
| `query` | object |  | Query string parameters |

## Prompts

Prompts are ready-made requests that tell the model which tools to call and what to report. In Claude Code they appear as slash commands, such as `/mcp__emby__library_report`.

### build_collection

Find everything in the library that fits a theme (a franchise, a director, a mood or an occasion) and make it into an Emby collection.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `theme` | yes | What the collection is, such as "Christopher Nolan films" or "cosy winter films" |
| `name` |  | The collection's name (default: suggest one) |

### library_report

A health check of the Emby library: what's in it, how well it's tagged and organised, gaps in the metadata, and suggestions.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `library` |  | Only this library (default all of them) |

### movie_night

Recommend a few unwatched films from the library for tonight, to suit a mood, the time you have and who's watching.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `mood` |  | What you're in the mood for, such as "funny", "tense" or "something like Arrival" |
| `minutes` |  | The most time you have, in minutes |
| `audience` |  | Who's watching, such as "family with a 9-year-old" or "just me" |
| `user` |  | Whose watched history to use (Emby user name) |

### suggest_collections

Look through the library for sets worth making: film series, directors and themes that aren't grouped yet.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `library` |  | Only this library |

### tag_library

Go through films (or series) and tag them by theme, mood or occasion, a batch at a time, with your approval before anything is saved.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tags` |  | Tags to use, comma-separated (default: suggest a vocabulary first) |
| `type` |  | Movie (default) or Series |
| `library` |  | Only this library |
| `batch` |  | How many items to look at per batch (default 50) |

### tidy_metadata

Find items with missing or wrong metadata (no plot, no TMDb match, no rating) and fix them by refreshing or editing, with your approval.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `library` |  | Only this library |
